_comment: One entry per source page (sources/<key>.qmd). tables: the release tables this source alone writes; shared: cross-source tables it contributes rows to; provenance: its `source` values in provenance.release. source-facts.js renders this against latest/manifest.json; tests/test_source_pages.py checks it against publish.TABLES.

bedbase.name: BEDbase
bedbase.covers: BED files and bedsets: GEO/ENCODE region sets, referenced not copied
bedbase.licence: No site-wide licence; every record is DUO:0000042 (general research use)

biogrid.name: BioGRID
biogrid.covers: Curated physical and genetic interactions, every organism

bugsigdb.name: BugSigDB
bugsigdb.covers: Curated microbial signatures and their taxa

cellosaurus.name: Cellosaurus
cellosaurus.covers: Cell lines, their cross-references and donor diseases

cellxgene.name: CELLxGENE
cellxgene.covers: Single-cell datasets: H5AD and Census pointers, ontology-tagged

encode.name: ENCODE
encode.covers: Experiments and files of the ENCODE portal, referenced not copied
encode.licence: ENCODE Data Use Policy (free use; cite the Consortium)

ensembl.name: Ensembl
ensembl.covers: Genes, transcripts and exons from the GTF of 276 species
ensembl.licence: No restrictions (Ensembl names no licence instrument)

eqtlcatalogue.name: eQTL Catalogue
eqtlcatalogue.covers: QTL datasets with summary-statistics URIs, referenced not copied

gwas_catalog.name: GWAS Catalog
gwas_catalog.covers: Variant-trait associations and the studies that report them

hgnc.name: HGNC
hgnc.covers: Approved human gene symbols, names and cross-references

icite.name: iCite
icite.covers: Citation metrics and the citation graph for every PubMed record

intact.name: IntAct
intact.covers: Molecular interaction evidence in PSI-MI MITAB

mane.name: MANE
mane.covers: The RefSeq to Ensembl matched transcript per human gene

ncbi_gene.name: NCBI Gene
ncbi_gene.covers: Entrez genes, GO annotations, PubMed links, accessions and orthologs, every organism

obo.name: Ontologies (OBO)
obo.covers: GO, CL, UBERON, MONDO, EFO, DOID, HsapDv and MmusDv terms and edges
obo.licence: Per ontology: CC BY 4.0, CC BY 3.0, CC0 1.0 or Apache 2.0

pubmed.name: PubMed
pubmed.covers: Citations: title, abstract, authors, MeSH, references, grants

pubtator3.name: PubTator3
pubtator3.covers: Genes, diseases, chemicals, species and variants mentioned in each paper

rnacentral.name: RNAcentral
rnacentral.covers: Non-coding RNA sequences and their member-database cross-references

uniprot.name: UniProt
uniprot.covers: Protein accession cross-references, human only so far

wikipathways.name: WikiPathways
wikipathways.covers: Pathways as Entrez gene sets, 18 species
